symbols.name: flanger_mono

params.name: dmax
params.description: maximum delay-line length (power of 2) - 10 ms typical

params.name: curdel
params.description: current dynamic delay (not to exceed dmax)

params.name: depth
params.description: effect strength between 0 and 1 (1 typical)

params.name: fb
params.description: feedback gain between 0 and 1 (0 typical)

params.name: invert
params.description: 0 for normal, 1 to invert sign of flanging sum

symbols.name: flanger_stereo
symbols.summary: Stereo flanging effect. `flanger_stereo` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: dmax
params.description: maximum delay-line length (power of 2) - 10 ms typical

params.name: curdel1
params.description: current dynamic delay for the left channel (not to exceed dmax)

params.name: curdel2
params.description: current dynamic delay for the right channel (not to exceed dmax)

params.name: depth
params.description: effect strength between 0 and 1 (1 typical)

params.name: fb
params.description: feedback gain between 0 and 1 (0 typical)

params.name: invert
params.description: 0 for normal, 1 to invert sign of flanging sum

symbols.name: phaser2_mono

params.name: Notches
params.description: number of spectral notches (MACRO ARGUMENT - not a signal)

params.name: phase
params.description: phase of the oscillator (0-1)

params.name: width
params.description: approximate width of spectral notches in Hz

params.name: frqmin
params.description: approximate minimum frequency of first spectral notch in Hz

params.name: fratio
params.description: ratio of adjacent notch frequencies

params.name: frqmax
params.description: approximate maximum frequency of first spectral notch in Hz

params.name: speed
params.description: LFO frequency in Hz (rate of periodic notch sweep cycles)

params.name: depth
params.description: effect strength between 0 and 1 (1 typical) (aka "intensity") when depth=2, "vibrato mode" is obtained (pure allpass chain)

params.name: fb
params.description: feedback gain between -1 and 1 (0 typical)

params.name: invert
params.description: 0 for normal, 1 to invert sign of flanging sum

references: 'An Allpass Approach to Digital Phasing and Flanging', Julius O. Smith III,
Proc. Int. Computer Music Conf. (ICMC-84), pp. 103-109, Paris, 1984.
